method.summary: Does the text this server returns to an agent carry the version the agent asked for? The #322 design (m-20261028-context7-version-correctness) applied unchanged to deepwiki: the same eight (subject, pinned version, contrast version, discriminator, counter, concept) tuples fixed on 2026-10-28, not re-drawn, plus one source repository per subject fixed in the pre-registration before any request. Each trial is one keyless tools/call to ask_wiki_question whose question is #322's text byte for byte ('In {subject} {pinned}, what do the docs say about {concept}?') and names neither identifier. The text scored is what the tool returns, which by the vendor's own tool description is an AI-synthesised answer grounded in a generated wiki, not a retrieved passage; it is what an agent calling this tool consumes. Scoring: case-sensitive substring, five outcomes declared in advance; n=8, one run, one container. THREE THINGS A READER MUST WEIGH. First, this server takes no version argument and indexes one branch per repository, so no trial can be served from an older corpus and the run cannot tell a chosen version from the only version. Second, each repository's default-branch version was read after the run (transcript section 8): five of the eight pinned versions (Bootstrap 5.3, Django 5.2, Laravel 11, Python 3.13, SQLAlchemy 2.0) are older than the default branch and three are its current major; the five are the trials that carry weight, and the one mixed outcome is among them. Third, the transcript's section 6 is EXPLORATORY, declared so before the run, and barred from these results: asked the same eight concepts for the CONTRAST (older) version, the server answered with only the newer identifier 5 of 8 times, both 3 of 8, and the older identifier alone 0 of 8; that is the part a reader deciding about this tool should read. The one baselined metric is the pre-registered question 'none wrong, or some wrong': baseline 1 is 'some'. It is not an estimate of a rate.
method.dataset: The eight (subject, pinned/contrast) trials of #322, unchanged: Vue 3/2, Bootstrap 5.3/4.6, Django 5.2/4.2, Tailwind CSS 4/3.4, Laravel 11/8, Pydantic 2/1.10, Python 3.13/3.8, SQLAlchemy 2.0/1.4; one source repository each, fixed in the pre-registration's table before any request.

results.metric: trials returning only the superseded version's identifier
trials returning the asked-for version's identifier only
trials with no answer (non-200, error or empty)
trials whose pinned version is older than the repository's default branch

disclosure.affiliationDetail: No relationship with the vendor. The conflict runs the other way: I wrote this registry's deepwiki entry and 45 of its 47 tool entries, so a result contradicting my own entry would cost me something. Every request and response is published for that reason.
